data.title: Checkout errors increased after a production change
data.customer_impact: Checkout completion rate is below the 99% service objective; customer-facing errors are active.
data.operator_note: Alert correlation tentatively points to checkout-service.
data.objective: Restore checkout success >=99%, p95 <=800ms, and critical services to healthy state.

payload.plan: AgentPlan(hypothesis='The recent deployment introduced a regression in the checkout-service that increases latency and error rate, possibly due to a misconfigured dependency or a new feature flag affecting payment processing.', steps=[PlanStep(step_id='S1', objective='Verify the health status of checkout-service instances and related dependencies (payment gateway, inventory service).', success_signal='All instances report healthy; dependency health checks pass.', status='pending'), PlanStep(step_id='S2', objective='Inspect recent deployments and feature flags for checkout-service; identify any changes made in the last 24 hours.', success_signal='Deployment logs show a new version with a feature flag toggled; no other changes detected.', status='pending'), PlanStep(step_id='S3', objective='Reproduce the checkout flow in a staging environment with the new deployment to capture latency and error metrics.', success_signal='Checkout flow completes with latency >800ms and error rate >1%.', status='pending'), PlanStep(step_id='S4', objective='Rollback the recent deployment or disable the suspect feature flag in production.', success_signal='Checkout success rate returns to ≥99% and p95 latency drops below 800ms.', status='pending'), PlanStep(step_id='S5', objective='Validate that the rollback restores overall system stability and no new errors appear.', success_signal='All monitoring dashboards show metrics within SLA and no new alerts.', status='pending'), PlanStep(step_id='S6', objective='Conduct a post‑mortem analysis to identify root cause and implement preventive controls (e.g., stricter canary testing, automated latency checks).', success_signal='Root cause documented; preventive controls added to CI/CD pipeline.', status='pending')], revision=0, rationale_summary='The alert correlation points to checkout-service, and the observed drop in checkout completion rate aligns with increased latency. A recent code change is the most likely cause, but other factors such as external service outages or infrastructure changes could also contribute. The hypothesis focuses on the service itself to guide targeted investigation.')

payload.plan: AgentPlan(hypothesis='The checkout-service latency spike is caused by a stale configuration cache that was not refreshed after the recent deployment, leading to repeated failed calls to the payment gateway. The deployment updated the config loader but did not invalidate the in-memory cache, causing the service to retry with exponential back‑off and exceed the timeout threshold.', steps=[PlanStep(step_id='S1', objective='Verify the current configuration cache contents in the checkout-service pods', success_signal='Cache contains the new config version but no refresh timestamp', status='pending'), PlanStep(step_id='S2', objective='Trigger a manual cache invalidation via the service’s health endpoint', success_signal='Cache refresh acknowledged and new config loaded', status='pending'), PlanStep(step_id='S3', objective='Re‑run a checkout flow against the service and capture latency metrics', success_signal='Checkout latency returns to baseline (<200ms) and error rate drops below 1%', status='pending')], revision=1, rationale_summary='The denial of a rollback forces us to investigate without reverting code. Observations show the checkout-service is healthy, but logs reveal repeated 502 responses from the payment gateway and a cache hit rate of 100% for the new config. A stale cache would explain the latency without affecting other services. This hypothesis directs us to validate cache state and gateway connectivity.')

payload.plan: AgentPlan(hypothesis='The latency spike is due to a transient network partition between checkout-service and the payment gateway, causing intermittent 502s and timeouts. The recent deployment introduced a new TLS certificate that is not yet propagated to the gateway, leading to handshake failures and retries.', steps=[PlanStep(step_id='S1', objective='Verify TLS handshake success from checkout-service to payment gateway', success_signal='openssl s_client -connect payment-gateway:443 returns handshake success', status='pending'), PlanStep(step_id='S2', objective='Check network latency and packet loss between services', success_signal='ping or traceroute shows <5ms latency and <1% packet loss', status='pending'), PlanStep(step_id='S3', objective='Inspect payment gateway logs for TLS errors', success_signal='gateway logs contain "handshake_failure" entries', status='pending'), PlanStep(step_id='S4', objective='Rotate the new TLS certificate on the gateway and reload config', success_signal='gateway reload completes without errors and handshake succeeds', status='pending'), PlanStep(step_id='S5', objective='Run end‑to‑end checkout flow to confirm latency normalizes', success_signal='checkout latency <200ms and no 502 responses', status='pending')], revision=2, rationale_summary='The 502 responses and high latency coincide with the deployment window, yet the cache hit rate remains 100% and no configuration changes were observed. A TLS mismatch would affect only the payment gateway calls, explaining why other services are unaffected. Network diagnostics show increased packet loss between the two pods.')

AgentPlan(hypothesis='The latency spike is caused by a stale DNS cache entry in the checkout-service pod that resolves the payment gateway to an old IP address. The old IP points to a node that is currently overloaded, leading to 502s and timeouts. The recent deployment updated the service discovery configuration, but the pod’s DNS cache was not refreshed, causing the mismatch.', steps=[PlanStep(step_id='S1', objective='Verify current DNS resolution for payment gateway from checkout-service pod', success_signal='dns_lookup_output shows IP different from expected gateway IP', status='pending'), PlanStep(step_id='S2', objective='Clear DNS cache in checkout-service pod (e.g., restart pod or flush cache)', success_signal='pod restarts without errors and new DNS lookup returns expected IP', status='pending'), PlanStep(step_id='S3', objective='Monitor checkout-service latency and 502 rates for 15 minutes post-cache flush', success_signal='latency drops below threshold and 502 rate <1%', status='pending')], revision=3, rationale_summary='DNS cache staleness explains why only checkout-service to payment gateway traffic is affected, while other services remain healthy. The 502s and high latency align with the deployment window, and packet loss diagnostics are consistent with routing to an overloaded node. Cache hit rate being 100% indicates internal caching is working, but external DNS resolution may be stale.')
